jobs.title: Operations Programme Manager
jobs.reason: Operations/programme management at a development consultancy sits outside the candidate's core targets (academic/policy research, geopolitical risk, OSINT/computational policy). The "Manager" title typically implies several years of programme management experience that the candidate, still completing their MSc with student-assistant roles, does not have. Minimal job detail provided, but the framing is generic operations rather than substantive research.

jobs.title: Subcontractor Automotive Auditor
jobs.reason: This is an automotive quality-management auditor role requiring an engineering/chemistry/IT degree, IATF 16949 certification, and 4+ years in the automotive supply industry — none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on multiple grounds (specialist technical qualifications, mandatory industry experience, Dutch working language).

jobs.title: Lead assessor / Senior assessor
jobs.reason: Social compliance auditing for supply-chain certification is unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence targets, and the role expects a background in safety/environmental engineering, chemical industry, or textiles plus willingness to travel extensively for factory audits in Taiwan. APSCA auditor registration is preferred and the work itself is a specialist assurance function the candidate has no exposure to.

jobs.title: Tutor
jobs.reason: This is a client training/assessor contractor role in Shanghai with no connection to IR, policy research, intelligence, or any of the candidate's target zones. The role likely requires Mandarin and specific assurance/assessor expertise the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor Aerospace Germany
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — aerospace quality-management auditing requires an engineering/technical degree and AS9100 audit experience, none of which the candidate has. Also triggers hard ineligibility on the 5-year aerospace industry experience requirement.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.reason: This is a B2B sales/account management role in the transportation and mobility certification sector — entirely outside the candidate's research/policy focus. Hard ineligibility also triggered: fluency in Japanese is required for the role, which the candidate does not have, and the role demands 3+ years of sector sales experience.

jobs.title: Contractor - IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: This is an automotive quality assurance auditing role requiring deep expertise in IATF 16949, AIAG core tools, and automotive OEM standards — none of which the candidate possesses. The field (automotive industry compliance auditing) is entirely unrelated to IR/policy research, and the role requires a senior certified Lead Auditor.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.reason: This is a B2B sales/account management role focused on revenue targets and pipeline management — pure sales, not policy, intelligence, or research. It also requires fluency in a regional business language (Mandarin/Cantonese in Shenzhen) which the candidate does not have, and 2+ years of B2B sales experience the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Managing Consultant- Low Carbon Solutions – Electricity Networks & Energy Systems (Mid-Senior level)
jobs.reason: This is a mid-senior energy consultancy role requiring deep technical expertise in electricity networks/markets, project leadership, and business development — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy field. Hard ineligibility on seniority (Managing Consultant level with team leadership and work-winning track record required).

jobs.title: Reputation Strategy & Research, Senior Consultant
jobs.reason: The role requires a hard minimum of 5-7 years' experience in a mixed-methods research agency, which triggers the hard ineligibility rule on years of experience. Field alignment is also only moderate — this is corporate reputation/communications research rather than the candidate's core IR, policy, or geopolitical risk targets.

jobs.title: Embedded Intelligence Analyst
jobs.reason: Commercial intelligence and geopolitical risk analysis at Sibylline is a core target zone, and the candidate's IR/security background, OSINT-adjacent research skills, and strong writing align well. The role asks for 1–3 years of intelligence/risk experience, which slightly exceeds the candidate's student-assistant background, and the unsociable rotating 5am–2pm shift pattern is a practical consideration but not disqualifying.

jobs.title: Operations Director (AD05)
jobs.reason: Senior director-level role requiring 10 years of operations experience including 5 years in senior leadership at a large organisation — a hard ineligibility trigger. The role is operational/administrative leadership at a business school, not policy or IR research, and is well outside the candidate's stage and field.

jobs.title: Research and Innovation Associate in Virtual Reality
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role explicitly requires a PhD (or near submission), which the candidate does not hold. The substantive focus on VR/XR development in Unity/Unreal for paediatric medical applications is also far outside the candidate's IR/policy field and technical skill set.

jobs.title: Research Associate/EMEA Analyst
jobs.reason: Verisk Maplecroft is a core target firm in the geopolitical risk space and the role's political/economic risk analysis aligns directly with the candidate's IR background. However, the role asks for at least three years of relevant professional experience plus specific Africa regional expertise, which the candidate lacks; the three-year requirement is stated but not framed as absolutely non-negotiable, so it's a stretch rather than a hard bar.
